name: Can I replace my bathtub with a walk-in shower?

mainEntity.name: Can I replace my bathtub with a walk-in shower?

acceptedAnswer.text: Yes, converting a bathtub into a walk-in shower is a popular remodeling option, especially for increasing accessibility or creating a more spacious feel. This process often involves removing the existing tub, modifying plumbing, building or installing a new shower pan, waterproofing, and installing new tile or a prefabricated unit. City Dweller specializes in these conversions, helping you design a functional and aesthetically pleasing walk-in shower.
acceptedAnswer.description: Yes, you can replace a bathtub with a walk-in shower. This involves removing the tub, modifying plumbing, installing a new shower pan, and finishing with tiles or a unit.
